title: Annotatio III §.VIII: Antesignani probe Conversion-mode every way — John of Paris joins; many opinions cited
pass_a_gloss: Opinions being adduced in a more copious number by John of Paris, associating himself with them, and from pp. 30 and 50 to 77.
pass_b_english: John of Paris joins those Antesignani.
From his pages 30 and 50–77 a more copious heap of opinions is adduced.
source_text: À Johanne Parisiensi, semet illis associante & à pag. 30. & 50. ad 77. Copiosiori numero adductis, opinionibus.
